creation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Aurelia Guardian collection visual-master board for adult magical-college Sanctuary. Image 1 is a STYLE and ornamentation reference (Solstice board); Image 2 is CHARACTER-MOTIF reference (canonical Aurelia, winged white rabbit). Create a new Aurelia collection board in the SAME exquisite richly rendered ornate gold-filigree 3D illustration style, but entirely DISTINCT palette: ivory cream, ruby-red velvet, rose gold, forest/sage green, soft peach highlights; absolutely no purple, violet, lavender or blue galaxy fabrics. Cozy, nurturing, books and feeding theme. Rabbit ears, feathered wings, roses, moons and warm stars in the objects, tasteful mature luxurious whimsical witch college dorm. NO actual guardian portrait/body. Arrange EXACTLY 28 distinct standalone full objects in tidy 7 columns x 4 rows with comfortable separation, on opaque neutral warm gray backdrop. No words, labels or titles. Row 1: bunny-ear reading chair; wingback reading chaise; quilted ruby canopy bed; sage-and-cream burrow hammock; round velvet footstool; rose-gold scholar writing desk; arched ivory astronomy bookcase. Row 2: rose crystal table lamp; wing-framed moon mirror; feather lantern; enchanted flowering sage planter; elegant paired feeding and water station; rose-gold potion apothecary; wing-embroidered burgundy and cream round rug. Row 3: rose tea table with pot and cups; jeweled feather play wand; sage-gold rune play ball; ruby treat puzzle carousel; bunny-shaped toy trunk; three ornate padded hopping stones as one set; hanging rose and star mobile. Row 4: ruby rose circlet; sage velvet moon collar; delicate rose-gold scholar glasses; wing-and-petal ruby cloak; sage leather scholar satchel; luminous rose-heart Arcane glass orb; majestic glowing Celestial rabbit dream altar with ivory winged rabbit motifs. Keep every object completely inside canvas. Detailed carved metal, velvet, embroidery, crystal glow; delicate readable silhouettes and practical game-object perspective, consistent light and scale, no text or watermarks.
